newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH AIDS DEATHS DECLINE TWO PCT IN 1995 - CBS.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH AIDS DEATHS DECLINE TWO PCT IN 1995 - CBS.

text.p: The number of Dutch AIDS related deaths declined two percent to 434 last year, the national statistics office CBS said on Monday.
It recorded 376 deaths among men, making Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome the second most prevalent cause of death after suicide among males aged 30-40.
Female deaths accounted for 58 cases, reflecting a rise in 1995 to one in seven of all AIDS deaths from an average of one in 30 in the years to 1990, CBS said.
The average age at time of death was 35 years for women and 41.5 years for men, it said.
